# The present on causal-set growth

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-present-on-causal-set-growth` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-present-on-causal-set-growth.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> On causal-set growth the present, read as the maximal elements of what a course has born, is a choice of course between bounds defined from precedence: a condition is present at a birth on some course exactly where it is a link (precedence weakly decided), on every course exactly at the one link.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Natural labellings. A natural labelling of a causal set renumbers its elements keeping precedence, each placed after what precedes it (NaturalLabelling, NaturalLabelling.at, NaturalLabelling.back, NaturalLabelling.before); the labels as they are form one (natural_identity). (`Becoming.Presence.NaturalLabelling`, `Becoming.Presence.NaturalLabelling.at`, `Becoming.Presence.NaturalLabelling.back`, `Becoming.Presence.NaturalLabelling.before`, `Becoming.Presence.natural_identity`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. A natural labelling gives a causal set of the kind: reading the label a as the element σ a gives a causal set onto which the labelling carries the first (relabel, relabel_ordered, natural_relabels), and every relabelling onto a causal set of the same size is a natural labelling (natural_of_relabels). (`Becoming.Presence.relabel`, `Becoming.Presence.relabel_ordered`, `Becoming.Presence.natural_relabels`, `Becoming.Presence.natural_of_relabels`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. The orders of birth. Every causal set is grown from the empty set, bearing the element t at offset t with its past (pastIn, pastIn_stem, courseOf, courseOf_grows, courseOf_isomorphic), and the natural labellings are exactly the numberings of its elements by a course from the empty set whose configuration at its size is of its kind (natural_iff_course).    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

What depends only on precedence: the natural labellings depend only on the size and the precedence (natural_congr), and so does whatever holds on every course or on some course, whatever is read on a course (every_congr, some_congr). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The laws on natural labellings, the stable partition, those defining the present at a stage (maximalBorn_iff_ends, maximalBorn_unrelated, maximalBorn_front) and the one link hold on every causal set of the growth (Causet.Ordered) with no decision on precedence, as do every_iff_not_not and together_every_iff_not_not. Each course form takes its law's decision.
- The laws on some course (before_some_iff, either_order, together_some_iff, antichain_present, present_some_iff_link) take precedence weakly decided on the causal set: of any two elements, the one does not precede the other or that it does not is refuted (the core's WeaklyDecided).
- prec_iff_every, past_every_iff, past_largest, together_every_iff, present_every_iff and least_iff_only_link take precedence decided (a Decidable instance); stem_born_first takes membership in the stem decided.
- Asked of every causal set, the direction of each law that needs its decision is exactly its principle: excluded middle for prec_iff_every, past_every_iff, together_every_iff, present_every_iff and least_iff_only_link, weak excluded middle for the five laws on some course. Each calibration is a lemma of its law, its meaning for the unfolding stated in UE14's NOTE (law 8).
- Modelling choices: finite labelled causal sets; natural labellings renumber the first size numbers and leave other values free, so the laws about an element carry its bound; presence read as being among the maximal elements of what has been born; covariance read as relabelling, courses compared by their orders of birth; antichains given by a Boolean test; pointwise, with no function extensionality.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Anything about continuous time, the present of a center or of experience, or presence on the theory's other models.
- Anything about transition probabilities, Bell causality, the continuum limit or infinite causal sets.
- That presence must be read so: being in the configuration, Dowker's birth and a maximal antichain of the whole configuration answer without varying with the course, stated in the note, not proved in Lean.
- A uniqueness theorem of Stein's kind: the past is singled out as the largest relation every course respects, not as the only one meeting conditions.
- Which presence or which course is better.
- **Counterexample:** On three elements, 0 below 1 and 2, 0 is present at 2's birth on one course and not on another, and the present after two births is exactly 1 on one course and exactly 2 on another (Vee.present_swap, Vee.not_present_identity, Vee.maximal_after_two_identity, Vee.maximal_after_two_swap). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Presence.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Asked of every causal set, born before, present together and the least element above on every course are each exactly excluded middle in their decided forms, and the laws on some course each exactly weak excluded middle, on witnesses of two and three elements whose precedences are propositions (every_iff_em, past_every_iff_em, together_every_iff_em, present_least_iff_em, either_order_iff_weakly, present_some_iff_weakly). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Presence.lean)
- **Counterexample:** On Wüthrich and Callender's four elements their relation is kept by every automorphism and is not what every course has born by a birth (Diamond.kept_not_agreed). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Presence.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Off the diamond, two elements with the same future and different pasts are present together on every course, and the past joined with being present together on every course is not transitive (SameFuture.together_different_pasts, SameFuture.pastOrTogether_not_trans). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Presence.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Causal set theory: natural labellings as linear extensions, links, partial stems with their correspondence to antichains, and discrete general covariance (Rideout and Sorkin 2000); stem sets through the first elements of natural labellings (Brightwell and others 2003), stem_born_first here on finite causal sets; each birth as the passage of time, unrelated births unordered (Dowker 2014), her present a birth, not this module's. Order theory: linear extensions are connected by exchanging adjacent incomparable elements (Mazurkiewicz 1977; the core's theorem), a finite order is the intersection of its linear extensions (Szpilrajn 1930; Dushnik and Miller 1941), and every antichain is the maximal elements of its down-closure; the laws on presence at a birth and on being present together are elementary consequences, not found stated there. Stein's theorem (1968, 1991), in Wüthrich and Callender's form (2017): the past is here the largest relation every course respects, a maximum, not uniqueness; on their four elements their relation is the past joined with being present together on every course, not in general. The calibrations: excluded middle and its weak form. Graded in UE14's NOTE.
